column1: # The package lock: every archive the assembly IMPORTS from the Debian
# registry instead of building. One file for both architectures; a row per
# archive. Written only by `make os-lock-bump COMPONENT=<name>`
# (build-env/deb/lock.sh), never by hand -- a lock diff is the reviewable
# import. Read by build-env/deb/fetch.sh (download + verify), rootfs/build.sh
